# Tools

50 tools. Tiers gate **registration**, not just execution — a tool whose tier is not
enabled never appears in `tools/list` at all, so it costs the client no context and offers no
affordance.

| Tier | Tools | Opt-in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `read` | 30 | Always registered. No environment opt-in required. |
| `write` | 13 | Registered only when `WEBSUPPORT_ALLOW_WRITE=1`. |
| `destructive` | 7 | Registered only when `WEBSUPPORT_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=1`, **and** every call must pass `confirm: true`. |

## `read`

Always registered. No environment opt-in required.

| Tool | Method + path | Confirm | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ws_auth_check` | `GET` `/v2/check` | — | Verify that the configured Websupport API key and secret authenticate successfully. |
| `ws_dns_zone_get` | `GET` `/v2/service/{service}/dns/zone` | — | Get the DNS zone attached to a service. |
| `ws_dns_record_list` | `GET` `/v2/service/{service}/dns/record` | — | List DNS records in a service zone, with paging and server-side filtering. |
| `ws_ftp_account_list` | `GET` `/v2/service/{service}/ftp-account` | — | List FTP accounts on a hosting service. |
| `ws_ftp_account_get` | `GET` `/v2/service/{service}/ftp-account/{ftpAccount}` | — | Get one FTP account by id. |
| `ws_user_get` | `GET` `/v1/user/self` | — | Get the account record: id, contact details, billing profiles, market and currency. |
| `ws_service_list` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/service` | — | List the account's services (hosting, domains, VPS and so on). |
| `ws_service_get` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/service/{serviceId}` | — | Get one service by id, including its type, status and expiry. |
| `ws_zone_list` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/zone` | — | List the DNS zones on the account. |
| `ws_zone_get` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/zone/{domain}` | — | Get one DNS zone by domain name. |
| `ws_hosting_list` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/hosting` | — | List the hosting services on the account. |
| `ws_hosting_get` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/hosting/{hostingId}` | — | Get one hosting service by id or uuid, including its package, limits and current usage. |
| `ws_hosting_vhost_list` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/hosting/{hostingId}/vhost` | — | List the virtual hosts (domains) served by a hosting service. |
| `ws_hosting_vhost_get` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/hosting/{hostingId}/vhost/{vhostId}` | — | Get one virtual host by id, including its document root and domain configuration. |
| `ws_hosting_stats` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/hosting/{hostingId}/size-stats` | — | Usage statistics for a hosting service. |
| `ws_db_list` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/hosting/{hostingId}/db` | — | List the databases on a hosting service. |
| `ws_db_get` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/hosting/{hostingId}/db/{databaseId}` | — | Get one database by id, including its name, type and connection details. |
| `ws_db_users_list` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/hosting/{hostingId}/dbusers` | — | List the database users on a hosting service. |
| `ws_db_stats` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/hosting/{hostingId}/db/{databaseId}/size-stats` | — | Usage statistics for one database. |
| `ws_mailbox_list` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/hosting/{hostingId}/mailbox` | — | List the mailboxes on a hosting service. |
| `ws_mailbox_get` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/hosting/{hostingId}/mailbox/{mailboxId}` | — | Get one mailbox by id, including its address, quota and forwarding configuration. |
| `ws_mail_stats` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/hosting/{hostingId}/mail/size-stats` | — | Mail storage statistics for a hosting service. |
| `ws_vps_list` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/vps` | — | List the VPS instances on the account. |
| `ws_vps_get` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/vps/{vpsId}` | — | Get one VPS by id or name, including its specification, IP addresses and power state. |
| `ws_vps_stats` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/vps/{vpsId}/cpu-stats` | — | Usage statistics for a VPS. |
| `ws_vps_vnc` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/vps/{vpsId}/vnc` | — | Get VNC console access details for a VPS. |
| `ws_invoice_list` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/invoice` | — | List the account's invoices with their amounts, dates and payment status. |
| `ws_invoice_get` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/invoice/{invoiceId}` | — | Get one invoice by id, including line items, totals and payment status. |
| `ws_invoice_pdf` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/invoice/{invoiceId}/raw-pdf` | — | Fetch an invoice as a PDF. |
| `ws_vps_snapshot_list` | `GET` `/v1/user/self/vps/{vpsId}/snapshot` | — | List the snapshots taken of a VPS, with their names and creation times. |

## `write`

Registered only when `WEBSUPPORT_ALLOW_WRITE=1`.

| Tool | Method + path | Confirm | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ws_dns_record_create` | `POST` `/v2/service/{service}/dns/record` | — | Create a DNS record in a service zone. |
| `ws_dns_record_update` | `PUT` `/v2/service/{service}/dns/record/{record}` | — | Update a DNS record by id. |
| `ws_ftp_account_create` | `POST` `/v2/service/{service}/ftp-account` | — | Create an FTP account. |
| `ws_ftp_account_update` | `PUT` `/v2/service/{service}/ftp-account/{ftpAccount}` | — | Update an FTP account by id. |
| `ws_domain_assign` | `POST` `/v2/service/{service}/assign-domain` | — | Assign a domain to a hosting service, optionally installing WordPress. |
| `ws_dyndns_update` | `GET` `/nic/update` | — | Best-effort Dynamic DNS update via the standard /nic/update endpoint. |
| `ws_db_create` | `POST` `/v1/user/self/hosting/{hostingId}/db` | — | Create a database on a hosting service. |
| `ws_db_update` | `PUT` `/v1/user/self/hosting/{hostingId}/db/{databaseId}` | — | Update a database. |
| `ws_mailbox_create` | `POST` `/v1/user/self/hosting/{hostingId}/domain/{domainId}/mailbox` | — | Create a mailbox on a domain. |
| `ws_mailbox_update` | `POST` `/v1/user/self/hosting/{hostingId}/domain/{domainId}/mailbox/{mailboxId}` | — | Update a mailbox. |
| `ws_vps_reboot` | `PUT` `/v1/user/self/vps/{vpsId}/reboot` | — | Gracefully reboot a VPS. |
| `ws_vps_snapshot_create` | `POST` `/v1/user/self/vps/{vpsId}/snapshot` | — | Take a snapshot of a VPS disk, so its current state can be restored later. |
| `ws_service_set_auto_extend` | `PUT` `/v1/user/self/service/{serviceId}` | — | Turn automatic renewal on or off for a service. |

## `destructive`

Registered only when `WEBSUPPORT_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=1`, **and** every call must pass `confirm: true`.

| Tool | Method + path | Confirm | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ws_dns_record_delete` | `DELETE` `/v2/service/{service}/dns/record/{record}` | required | Permanently delete a DNS record by id. |
| `ws_ftp_account_delete` | `DELETE` `/v2/service/{service}/ftp-account/{ftpAccount}` | required | Permanently delete an FTP account. |
| `ws_db_delete` | `DELETE` `/v1/user/self/hosting/{hostingId}/db/{databaseId}` | required | Permanently delete a database and everything stored in it. |
| `ws_mailbox_delete` | `DELETE` `/v1/user/self/hosting/{hostingId}/domain/{domainId}/mailbox/{mailboxId}` | required | Permanently delete a mailbox and every message stored in it. |
| `ws_vps_hard_reboot` | `PUT` `/v1/user/self/vps/{vpsId}/hard-reboot` | required | Force a VPS to power-cycle without letting the guest shut down. |
| `ws_vps_snapshot_restore` | `POST` `/v1/user/self/vps/{vpsId}/snapshot/{name}` | required | Overwrite the VPS disk with the named snapshot. |
| `ws_vps_snapshot_delete` | `DELETE` `/v1/user/self/vps/{vpsId}/snapshot/{name}` | required | Permanently delete a VPS snapshot. |
